data.notes: June 2026 is a peak music-travel month, with Rock in Rio anchoring Lisbon and beach-led dance/rap programming stretching to Costa da Caparica and Portimão.

events.title: Father John Misty
events.summary: Father John Misty opens his European summer run with a Lisbon concert at Sagres Campo Pequeno, performing material from Mahashmashana and his wider singer-songwriter catalogue.

events.title: Doja Cat – Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat brings the Ma Vie World Tour to Lisbon’s MEO Arena, with Naomi Sharon listed as support by Live Nation Portugal.

events.title: Intercell Lisbon with Funk Tribu, Supergloss and LAMMER
events.summary: Amsterdam-born techno brand Intercell returns to Lisbon for an open-air session under Ponte 25 de Abril, with Funk Tribu, Supergloss, LAMMER, Kokeshi and Maria Callapez on the RA-listed lineup.

events.title: Conan Gray – Wishbone World Tour 26
events.summary: Conan Gray makes his first Portugal appearance at MEO Arena on the Wishbone World Tour 26, following the release of his album Wishbone.

events.title: SuncéBeat New Horizons Lisbon 2026
events.summary: SuncéBeat New Horizons returns to Costa da Caparica with house, funk, soul, disco, R&B and live/DJ programming across Irmão, Praia da Sereia afterparties and boat parties. The confirmed lineup includes Kenny Dope, Louie Vega, Chez Damier, DJ Spen, Jeremy Underground, Henrik Schwarz and more.

events.title: Excursions: Lisbon 2026
events.summary: Chicago house institution Excursions lands at Rive Rouge with Cordell Johnson, James Vincent and Godi Osegueda for a late-night Lisbon session.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 20: Katy Perry, Charlie Puth, Pedro Sampaio, Calema and Alok
events.summary: The opening Saturday of Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 is led by Katy Perry and Charlie Puth, with Pedro Sampaio, Calema, Alok, Audrey Nuna, Nena, Maninho, Bebe Rexha, Napa and Sofia Camara also listed.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 21: Linkin Park, Cypress Hill and The Pretty Reckless
events.summary: Rock in Rio Lisboa’s June 21 bill is headed by Linkin Park, with Cypress Hill, The Pretty Reckless, Grandson, Kaiser Chiefs, Hoobastank, Sepultura, P.O.D. and Portuguese acts including Sam The Kid with Orquestra e Orelha Negra.

events.title: Adrena +++ with Vladimir Dubyshkin, slin, INLIMEN and Handerson
events.summary: Riktus and ANOITECERATENTO present an Adrena techno night at Ministerium Club, headlined by Vladimir Dubyshkin in hybrid live format with slin, INLIMEN and Handerson.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 27: Rod Stewart, Cyndi Lauper, Shaggy and 4 Non Blondes
events.summary: Rock in Rio Lisboa’s June 27 lineup brings classic pop and rock names including Rod Stewart, Cyndi Lauper, Shaggy, 4 Non Blondes, Xutos & Pontapés, GNR, UHF, Jafumega, Joss Stone, Belo, The Wailers and Syro.

events.title: Rhythm + Waves 2026
events.summary: Rhythm + Waves debuts on Praia da Rocha in Portimão with a rap and electronic lineup listing A Boogie Wit da Hoodie, Gunna, Chase & Status, Ken Carson, D-Block Europe, Destroy Lonely, Skream, Andy C, Sherelle and more.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 28: 21 Savage, Central Cee, Rema and Matuê
events.summary: The final day of Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 is a hip-hop, Afrobeats and pop-leaning bill headed by 21 Savage, Central Cee, Rema and Matuê, with Filipe Ret, Dennis, Carlão, Irina Barros, Lola Índigo and CeeLo Green also confirmed.
